name: a-devbar-grip-drag-reorders-the-sidebar
description:
A real cgevent drag from the devbar grip onto the sidebar, above row 0. The bar is its own document, so this is the check that the sidebar takes a drag it did not start: it moves the tab's row to the drop slot while the pointer is over it, and its drop sends one sidebarTabReordered that moves the bar's tab to the top.

Both rows are clicked live first, and the second click leaves row 1 active, so the bar shows row 1's tab. The grip point comes from the bar's own screen origin. The drop point is the top edge of row 0, read from the sidebar.

actions.expression: (() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane) [data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow')]; if (rows.length < 2) { return 'rows ' + rows.length; } rows[0].click(); return 'clicked'; })()

(() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane) [data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow')]; if (rows.length < 2) { return 'rows ' + rows.length; } rows[1].click(); return 'clicked'; })()

(() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane) [data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow')]; if (rows.length < 2) { return 'rows ' + rows.length; } return rows.slice(0, 2).map((r) => r.dataset.tabId ? 'live' : 'cold').join(','); })()

(() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane) [data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow')]; if (rows.length < 2) { return 'rows ' + rows.length; } window.__dragId = rows[1].dataset.tabId; window.__cs = []; window.__lines = 0; document.addEventListener('dragover', () => { const first = document.querySelector('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane) [data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow'); if (first && first.dataset.tabId === window.__dragId) { window.__lines += 1; } }, true); const orig = chrome.send.bind(chrome); chrome.send = (name, args) => { if (name.startsWith('sidebarTab')) { window.__cs.push(name + ':' + args.join(',')); } return orig(name, args); }; return window.__dragId ? 'spying' : 'cold'; })()

(() => { const o = window.atriumDevBarScreenOrigin; const g = document.querySelector('.dvgrip'); if (!o || !g) { return 'none'; } const b = g.getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round(o[0] + b.left + b.width / 2) + ',' + Math.round(o[1] + b.top + b.height / 2); })()

(() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane) [data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow')][0]; if (!r) { return 'none'; } const b = r.getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round(b.left + b.width / 2) + ',' + Math.round(30 + b.top + 3); })()
actions.note: The top edge of row 0, so the row moves above it. The window sits 30 below the screen top.

actions.expression: (() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane) [data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow')]; return rows[0] && rows[0].dataset.tabId === window.__dragId ? 'dragged-first' : 'unchanged'; })()
(() => { const line = document.querySelector('.dropline'); return (!line || line.hidden) && !document.querySelector('.rowghost') ? 'cleared' : 'still shown'; })()

assertions.desc: one window, so the release did not tear the tab off
and the second, which the bar now shows
the bar is up with its grip
both rows are live, so each carries a tab id
the sidebar moved the row to the drop slot for a drag from another document
THE MEASUREMENT: exactly one reorder, row 1 to the top, and no split
the bar's tab now leads the list
the preview did not outlive the gesture
